name: Local dev servers
ownerWords: A 200 check is a good duty too. Hand the 200 checks of the wiki, the frontend app, Convex and the crawler API in the local environment to the ops chat. Also, on 10-09: have it your duty to have usable mac.
goal: The owner's Mac stays usable (load under 20, at least 30% memory free, and its search app :5174 and design demo :5180 answer 200), the wiki (the wiki url in hosts.json), the search app (localhost:5174), local Convex and the local crawler-v3 API each answer 200 within 5 s, the wiki's process tree stays under 4096 MB, and the wiki or search restarts at most once a day. Tell the owner only when a server does not answer, the wiki is over its cap, a server keeps restarting, or the Mac is overloaded.

metrics.label: Real memory of the wiki's process tree (llm-wiki.service on us-metal02, pm2 elsewhere)
Restarts of the wiki (systemd or pm2) or search (pm2) since the last run
Checks failing on the owner's Mac: load under 20, at least 30% memory free, and the search app :5174 and design demo :5180 answering 200 (an asleep Mac reads mac_unreachable instead)

onMiss: Read the flagged items; each service's answer is there, and by_design means the search app uses a remote one. Wiki not answering, over its cap or restarting: on us-metal02 read `journalctl --user -u llm-wiki.service -n 200 --no-pager`, find the cause, and run `systemctl --user restart llm-wiki.service` only if it still does not answer; where pm2 runs it, read `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 logs llm-wiki --lines 200 --nostream` in auto-sns-agent instead. Search not answering: in auto-sns-agent read `PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev node_modules/.bin/pm2 logs search --lines 200 --nostream`, find the cause, and restart it with that pm2 only if it still does not answer. Convex or crawler: run `node scripts/dev/devstack.mjs status` and follow ops/runbooks/local-runtime.md. Restarting: find the root (dev-guard.mjs logs exits; `Stopping app` in .cache/pm2-dev/pm2.log is a restart command) and start one job that fixes it with `commit.mjs --object-only --push-ci ci/<name>`. Tell the owner what broke and whether it answers now. Mac checks failing: read the Mac's top CPU and memory users over ssh, cut what an agent started, and name any thread to pause, without opening or moving windows on his screen (c103). All on target: no message.
